## Summary

Fixed the redirect loop issue in post edits by changing the `PostController.update()` method to use `this.redirect()` instead of manually creating a Response with HTTP 302 status code. The problem was that 302 (Found) tells the browser to repeat the same request method (PUT) to the new location, creating an infinite redirect loop. The Guren framework's `this.redirect()` automatically uses HTTP 303 (See Other) for non-GET requests, which correctly instructs the browser to change the method to GET. This fix makes the update action consistent with the create and delete actions, which already use `this.redirect()`, and resolves the `ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS` error users were experiencing when saving post edits.
